name: DailyOps REST to Telegram
description: Experimental example pack that reads a normalized daily operations JSON endpoint and sends one Telegram report.

config_schema.label: Source URL
config_schema.description: Absolute HTTP(S) endpoint returning the normalized DailyOps JSON contract.

config_schema.label: Telegram chat ID
config_schema.description: Target chat, group, or channel identifier for delivery.

config_schema.label: Report title
config_schema.description: Title shown in the appliance setup screen.

config_schema.label: Low-stock threshold
config_schema.description: Optional planning threshold for future vendor adapters.

credential_requirements.label: Telegram bot token
credential_requirements.description: Encrypted Telegram bot token used to send the report.
